name: nop-stream-cdc
description: Upgrade the nop Debezium integration to 3.7.0.Final and close the gap to SeaTunnel for single-machine DB-to-DB sync: connector whitelist mysql+postgres, two-layer single-host parallelism (engine-internal chunked parallel snapshot passthrough + nop-stream subtask-level deterministic table routing), JdbcSchemaHistory as default schema-history store with the nop checkpoint pinned as the single offset source of truth, jdbc-2pc dmlMode (INSERT/UPSERT/UPSERT_DELETE) for CDC mirroring with the existing epoch 2PC + ledger idempotency, engine single-writer pinning and config guards, and two gated Testcontainers reference scenarios (mysql->mysql mirror with kill/recover; pg->mysql with DELETE propagation) as the SeaTunnel-replacement acceptance bar. Design decisions are recorded in ai-dev/design/nop-stream/cdc-design.md; the prior CDC implementation was never released, so there is no backward-compatibility burden.
